technical.summary: Strong technical structure with bullish trend confirmation across multiple timeframes, but overbought conditions on short-term oscillators and weak volume accumulation create pullback risk; suitable for scaled entry or confirmation of reversal.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 108 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (97+ days old) with no clear conviction from junior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (319), and macro score deeply negative (-4); earnings 108 days out poses minimal near-term binary risk but overall environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and DC20 breakout confirms uptrend structure; extreme market fear (29/100) presents classic contrarian buy setup in oversold sentiment environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 319, macro score -4), overbought short-term oscillators (RSI 74.24, StochRSI, Williams %R), weak volume accumulation (CMF negative, vol ratio 0.97), and zero fundamental support (no insider buying, no institutional alignment, high earnings risk in 108 days) create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but overbought oscillators (RSI 74.24) at resistance create poor entry timing. Extreme market fear presents contrarian opportunity, but macro environment is severely unfavourable with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 319, macro score -4) combined with overbought technicals and zero fundamental support create asymmetric downside risk; earnings event in 108 days adds event risk.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but risk and fundamental agents strongly oppose; debate winner is bear with medium confidence.
